description: An understand run over every area of the webforms-shop fixture, one reader task per area in code-map order: (root) answers the catalogue FLOW and its SCRN, Catalog the add-to-basket FLOW and the details SCRN, Orders the order FLOW, two SCRN cards and an OQ card for a suspected path, and Services, a library with no entry point and no page, one BR card and no FLOW or SCRN. Every task reads one file first. Written by hand for the fake provider; no real provider was called.
